dedupe_keys.name: powerfactory tools python package to control digsilent powerfactory

description: PowerFactory-Tools is an open Python package that automates the commercial power system analysis program DIgSILENT PowerFactory through the vendor's Python API, running PowerFactory from a Python script in engine mode. It is developed by the Institute of Electrical Power Systems and High Voltage Engineering at TU Dresden, with authors including Sebastian Krahmer, Sasan Jacob Rasti, Laura Fiedler and Maximilian Schmidt, and has 26 tagged releases up to 3.4.1 (July 2026), each archived on Zenodo. It supports PowerFactory versions from 2022 onwards and offers typed interfaces with autocompletion, general unit conversion, an exporter that writes grid data from PowerFactory to an open format, and tutorials. Coverage is not tied to a place. The code is accessible on GitHub under the BSD 3-clause licence at no cost. Caveats: a licensed PowerFactory installation is needed, and behaviour depends on the vendor API version. Simulation uses are batch load flow, short-circuit and contingency studies and exporting utility grid models for other tools. Related records: model-easy-simauto-esa plays the same role for PowerWorld Simulator.
